title: Dual-fibrous PTFE structure enabling uniform and thick dry electrodes for high-energy-density and long-lasting batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03240G, Paper
Kwon-Hyung Lee, Hyeongseok Shim, Sang Hyun Lee, Hyeong-Jong Kim, Chanhyun Park, Jingyu Choi, Seok-Ju Lee, Young-Kuk Hong, Jihong Lyu, Jin Chul Kim, Sijeong Park, Hyungyeon Cha, Wooyoung Jin, Jinsoo Kim, Sinho Choi, Sang-Young Lee, Sung-Kyun Jung, Michael De Volder, Tae-Hee Kim, Gyujin Song
